productArea.name: Issues
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, create, and edit issues across global, organization, and repository lists, including comments, assignments, dependencies, due dates, time tracking, bulk actions, and issue tracker settings. Label, milestone, and project selection is included, but managing those resources and pull requests is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Issues in the global navigation and use its search, ownership, state, and project filters.
Choose Issues in the seeded repository and open an issue for its discussion, sidebar assignments, dependencies, and time tracking.
Choose Settings and inspect only the issue tracker configuration controls.
Choose an organization and open its Issues dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if needed.
